description: This file defines the class DefaultPayloadPathMatcher, a utility class implementing the PayloadPathMatcher interface. It provides methods to create path matcher instances from pattern maps, including an empty matcher, and to match JSON pointer paths against the stored patterns to retrieve associated entity names, throwing an exception if no match is found.

classes.name: DefaultPayloadPathMatcher
classes.description: A final class that implements the PayloadPathMatcher interface, providing pattern-based path matching functionality for payload paths.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Static factory method to create a new DefaultPayloadPathMatcher instance from a map of pattern entries.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Static method to create an instance that does not match any patterns, effectively an empty path matcher.

methods.name: match
methods.description: Overrides PayloadPathMatcher's match method to match a given JsonPointer path against known patterns and return the associated key, or throw UnknownPathException if no match is found.
